thig5.4:1.1: āturaṃ asuciṃ pūtiṃ passa Nande samussayaṃ | asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ. || ||
thig5.4:2.1: yathā idaṃ tathā etaṃ yathā etaṃ tathā idaṃ | duggandhaṃ pūtikaṃ vāti bālānaṃ abhinanditaṃ. || ||
thig5.4:3.1: evaṃ etaṃ avekkhantī rattindivam atanditā | tato sakāya paññāya abhinibbijja dakkhisaṃ. || ||
thig5.4:4.1: tassā me appamattāya vicinantiyā yoniso | yathābhūtaṃ ayaṃ kāyo diṭṭho santarabāhiro. || ||
thig5.4:5.1: atha nibbind' ahaṃ kāye ajjhattañ ca virajj' ahaṃ | appamattā visaṃyuttā upasanta mhi nibbutā. || || Nandā. ||
